dedupe_keys.name: infrastructuresystems jl shared model data structures

description: InfrastructureSystems.jl is a Julia package of shared data structures and utilities for infrastructure simulation in the Sienna software family. PowerSystems.jl, PowerSimulations.jl and PowerSimulationsDynamics.jl use it to represent and handle infrastructure components consistently. Inputs are programmatic component definitions and model metadata; outputs are objects passed to downstream modelling and simulation packages. Geographic coverage and time scale follow the application, not any bundled dataset. The repository provides BSD-3-Clause source, stable documentation and support for Julia 1.6 or newer. A limitation is that this library is a supporting layer, not a standalone power-flow or dynamics solver; users need the relevant Sienna packages and a system model. Its main use is to prepare reproducible electricity-infrastructure models and exchange common structures across Sienna tools. Related electricity models include PyPSA (model-pypsa), but interoperability was not tested.
